# NEW 2026-11-18 themes muster for the conquest campaigns (track D). Generated by gen_theme_muster.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# ======================== levies ========================
# Theme scope. One regiment ($inf$ infantry or $cav$ cavalry, one in all) of the current age for the empire, at the
# theme's seat while the empire controls it, else at the imperial capital; nothing once 8 regiments were raised
# in this campaign. oe_hcr_units is defined by gen_heg_reactions.py.
oe_tmc_add_reg = {
    if = {
        limit = { c:BYZ = { has_variable = oe_tmc_n_regs var:oe_tmc_n_regs < 8 } }
        c:BYZ = {
            save_scope_as = oe_tmc_byz
            change_variable = { name = oe_tmc_n_regs add = 1 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { capital ?= { controller ?= c:BYZ } }
            capital = { oe_hcr_units = { inf = $inf$ cav = $cav$ owner = oe_tmc_byz } }
        }
        else = {
            c:BYZ = { capital ?= { oe_hcr_units = { inf = $inf$ cav = $cav$ owner = oe_tmc_byz } } }
        }
    }
}
# Theme scope. The theme has answered the summons.
oe_tmc_mark_sent = {
    set_variable = oe_tmc_sent
    remove_variable = oe_tmc_late
    remove_variable = oe_tmc_refused
    c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_tmc_n_sent add = 1 } }
}
# Theme scope. A loyal theme: one infantry and one cavalry regiment.
oe_tmc_send_two = {
    oe_tmc_mark_sent = yes
    oe_tmc_add_reg = { inf = 1 cav = 0 }
    oe_tmc_add_reg = { inf = 0 cav = 1 }
}
# Theme scope. One regiment: cavalry from a frontier theme, infantry from the others.
oe_tmc_send_one = {
    oe_tmc_mark_sent = yes
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ts_frontier = yes }
        oe_tmc_add_reg = { inf = 0 cav = 1 }
    }
    else = {
        oe_tmc_add_reg = { inf = 1 cav = 0 }
    }
}
# Theme scope. The theme hands over oe_tmc_fine_value (at most 100 gold) to the imperial treasury.
oe_tmc_fine = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_fine_amt value = oe_tmc_fine_value }
    save_scope_as = oe_tmc_payer
    add_gold = { value = var:oe_tmc_fine_amt multiply = -1 }
    c:BYZ = { add_gold = { value = scope:oe_tmc_payer.var:oe_tmc_fine_amt } }
    remove_variable = oe_tmc_fine_amt
}

# ======================== campaign start ========================
# BYZ scope. Hook: oe_hc_<r>_start, right after oe_hcr_<r>_on_start (the campaign wars exist and oe_hc_<r>_active is set).
oe_tmc_on_start = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_r value = flag:$r$ }
    set_variable = oe_tmc_on
    remove_variable = oe_tmc_done_2
    remove_variable = oe_tmc_done_3
    remove_variable = oe_tmc_done_4
    remove_variable = oe_tmc_done_5
    remove_variable = oe_tmc_cd
    every_subject = {
        limit = { OR = { has_variable = oe_tmc_sent has_variable = oe_tmc_late has_variable = oe_tmc_refused has_variable = oe_tmc_glory } }
        remove_variable = oe_tmc_sent
        remove_variable = oe_tmc_late
        remove_variable = oe_tmc_refused
        remove_variable = oe_tmc_glory
    }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_n_sent value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_n_regs value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_n_late value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_n_refused value = 0 }
    # Loyal themes first, so that they fill the levy cap before the steady ones.
    every_subject = {
        limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes var:oe_theme_loyalty_band ?= 3 }
        oe_tmc_send_two = yes
    }
    every_subject = {
        limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes var:oe_theme_loyalty_band ?= 2 }
        oe_tmc_send_one = yes
    }
    every_subject = {
        limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes var:oe_theme_loyalty_band ?= 1 }
        set_variable = oe_tmc_late
        c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_tmc_n_late add = 1 } }
    }
    every_subject = {
        limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes var:oe_theme_loyalty_band ?= 0 }
        set_variable = oe_tmc_refused
        c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_tmc_n_refused add = 1 } }
    }
    # Open refusal: pressure +3 for each such theme, at most +15.
    set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_refuse_press value = { value = var:oe_tmc_n_refused multiply = 3 max = 15 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_pay_cost value = { value = var:oe_tmc_n_refused multiply = 60 } }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_tmc_refuse_press var:oe_tmc_refuse_press > 0 }
        oe_hc_$r$_add_pressure = { amount = var:oe_tmc_refuse_press }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { any_subject = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes } }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tmc.1
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Event 1 b/c: every refuser complies with one regiment; the pressure from the refusals is taken back.
oe_tmc_comply = {
    every_subject = {
        limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes has_variable = oe_tmc_refused }
        oe_tmc_send_one = yes
    }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_refund value = { value = var:oe_tmc_refuse_press multiply = -1 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_active } oe_hc_egypt_add_pressure = { amount = var:oe_tmc_refund } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_africa_active } oe_hc_africa_add_pressure = { amount = var:oe_tmc_refund } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_italy_active } oe_hc_italy_add_pressure = { amount = var:oe_tmc_refund } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_france_active } oe_hc_france_add_pressure = { amount = var:oe_tmc_refund } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_iberia_active } oe_hc_iberia_add_pressure = { amount = var:oe_tmc_refund } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_britain_active } oe_hc_britain_add_pressure = { amount = var:oe_tmc_refund } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_persia_active } oe_hc_persia_add_pressure = { amount = var:oe_tmc_refund } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_blacksea_active } oe_hc_blacksea_add_pressure = { amount = var:oe_tmc_refund } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_arabia_active } oe_hc_arabia_add_pressure = { amount = var:oe_tmc_refund } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_refuse_press value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_n_refused value = 0 }
}

# ======================== during the campaign ========================
# BYZ scope, monthly while a campaign runs (on_action below).
oe_tmc_monthly = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_active } set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_prog value = var:oe_hc_egypt_progress } set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_press value = var:oe_hc_egypt_pressure } set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_months value = var:oe_hc_egypt_months } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_africa_active } set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_prog value = var:oe_hc_africa_progress } set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_press value = var:oe_hc_africa_pressure } set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_months value = var:oe_hc_africa_months } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_italy_active } set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_prog value = var:oe_hc_italy_progress } set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_press value = var:oe_hc_italy_pressure } set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_months value = var:oe_hc_italy_months } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_france_active } set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_prog value = var:oe_hc_france_progress } set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_press value = var:oe_hc_france_pressure } set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_months value = var:oe_hc_france_months } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_iberia_active } set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_prog value = var:oe_hc_iberia_progress } set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_press value = var:oe_hc_iberia_pressure } set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_months value = var:oe_hc_iberia_months } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_britain_active } set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_prog value = var:oe_hc_britain_progress } set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_press value = var:oe_hc_britain_pressure } set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_months value = var:oe_hc_britain_months } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_persia_active } set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_prog value = var:oe_hc_persia_progress } set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_press value = var:oe_hc_persia_pressure } set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_months value = var:oe_hc_persia_months } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_blacksea_active } set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_prog value = var:oe_hc_blacksea_progress } set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_press value = var:oe_hc_blacksea_pressure } set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_months value = var:oe_hc_blacksea_months } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_arabia_active } set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_prog value = var:oe_hc_arabia_progress } set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_press value = var:oe_hc_arabia_pressure } set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_months value = var:oe_hc_arabia_months } }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_tmc_cd }
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_ts_cd }
            oe_story_gap_open = yes
            OR = { oe_tmc_can_2 = yes oe_tmc_can_3 = yes oe_tmc_can_4 = yes oe_tmc_can_5 = yes }
        }
        random = {
            chance = 4
            random_list = {
                30 = { trigger = { oe_tmc_can_2 = yes } oe_tmc_pick_2 = yes }
                25 = { trigger = { oe_tmc_can_3 = yes } oe_tmc_pick_3 = yes }
                25 = { trigger = { oe_tmc_can_4 = yes } oe_tmc_pick_4 = yes }
                20 = { trigger = { oe_tmc_can_5 = yes } oe_tmc_pick_5 = yes }
            }
        }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Spacing after a campaign event: 8 months for this track, 4 months for the theme story pack.
oe_tmc_spacing = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_cd months = 8 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ts_cd months = 4 }
    oe_story_gap_set = yes
}
# BYZ scope. Pick the theme(s) for event N and fire it.
oe_tmc_pick_2 = {
    set_variable = oe_tmc_done_2
    random_subject = {
        limit = { oe_tmc_sent_ok = yes has_variable = oe_theme_loyalty_band var:oe_theme_loyalty_band >= 2 }
        save_scope_as = oe_tmc_pick
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_tmc_pick }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_t2 value = scope:oe_tmc_pick }
        oe_tmc_spacing = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tmc.2
    }
}
oe_tmc_pick_3 = {
    set_variable = oe_tmc_done_3
    random_subject = {
        limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes has_ruler = yes has_variable = oe_tmc_late }
        save_scope_as = oe_tmc_pick
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_tmc_pick }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_t3 value = scope:oe_tmc_pick }
        oe_tmc_spacing = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tmc.3
    }
}
oe_tmc_pick_4 = {
    set_variable = oe_tmc_done_4
    random_subject = { limit = { oe_tmc_sent_ok = yes } save_scope_as = oe_tmc_pick }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_tmc_pick }
        random_subject = { limit = { oe_tmc_sent_ok = yes NOT = { this = scope:oe_tmc_pick } } save_scope_as = oe_tmc_pick2 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_tmc_pick exists = scope:oe_tmc_pick2 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_t4a value = scope:oe_tmc_pick }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_t4b value = scope:oe_tmc_pick2 }
        oe_tmc_spacing = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tmc.4
    }
}
# The strategos who led the vanguard (event 2 a) is three times as likely to be the one who falls.
oe_tmc_pick_5 = {
    set_variable = oe_tmc_done_5
    random_subject = {
        limit = { oe_tmc_sent_ok = yes }
        weight = {
            base = 1
            modifier = { add = 2 has_variable = oe_tmc_glory }
        }
        save_scope_as = oe_tmc_pick
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_tmc_pick }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_t5 value = scope:oe_tmc_pick }
        oe_tmc_spacing = yes
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tmc.5
    }
}

# ======================== campaign end ========================
# BYZ scope. Hook: oe_hc_<r>_end_1 / _2 / _3 with outcome 1 victory, 2 negotiated peace, 3 defeat.
# Pending marks (oe_tmc_rew answered, oe_tmc_pun refused) survive the next muster until events 6 and 7 settle them.
oe_tmc_on_end = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_last_r value = flag:$r$ }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_outcome value = $outcome$ }
    remove_variable = oe_tmc_on
    every_subject = {
        limit = { OR = { has_variable = oe_tmc_rew has_variable = oe_tmc_pun } }
        remove_variable = oe_tmc_rew
        remove_variable = oe_tmc_pun
    }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_n_rew value = 0 }
    every_subject = {
        limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes has_variable = oe_tmc_sent }
        set_variable = oe_tmc_rew
        c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_tmc_n_rew add = 1 } }
    }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_gift_cost value = { value = var:oe_tmc_n_rew multiply = 40 max = 400 } }
    # Dispatch by name: a limit on a variable set in this block would log errors in tooltip passes.
    oe_tmc_end_$outcome$ = yes
}
oe_tmc_end_1 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_n_pun value = 0 }
    every_subject = {
        limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes has_variable = oe_tmc_refused }
        set_variable = oe_tmc_pun
        c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_tmc_n_pun add = 1 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { any_subject = { has_variable = oe_tmc_rew } }
        trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_tmc.6 days = 3 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { any_subject = { has_variable = oe_tmc_pun } }
        trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_tmc.7 days = 20 }
    }
    # The hero: the strategos who led the vanguard, else 40% a random answering strategos.
    remove_variable = oe_tmc_hero
    if = {
        limit = { any_subject = { oe_tmc_sent_ok = yes has_variable = oe_tmc_glory } }
        random_subject = { limit = { oe_tmc_sent_ok = yes has_variable = oe_tmc_glory } save_scope_as = oe_tmc_hero_pick }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { any_subject = { oe_tmc_sent_ok = yes } }
        random = {
            chance = 40
            random_subject = { limit = { oe_tmc_sent_ok = yes } save_scope_as = oe_tmc_hero_pick }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_tmc_hero_pick }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_hero value = scope:oe_tmc_hero_pick }
        trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_tmc.8 days = 45 }
    }
}
oe_tmc_end_2 = {
    if = {
        limit = { any_subject = { has_variable = oe_tmc_rew } }
        trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_tmc.6 days = 3 }
    }
}
oe_tmc_end_3 = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            any_subject = {
                oe_theme_member_trigger = yes
                OR = { has_variable = oe_tmc_rew oe_ts_frontier = yes }
            }
        }
        trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_tmc.6 days = 3 }
    }
}

# ======================== test helpers (dev mod buttons, console) ========================
# BYZ scope. Run the muster for the running campaign (console: effect oe_tmc_test_start = yes).
oe_tmc_test_start = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_active } oe_tmc_on_start = { r = egypt } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_africa_active } oe_tmc_on_start = { r = africa } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_italy_active } oe_tmc_on_start = { r = italy } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_france_active } oe_tmc_on_start = { r = france } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_iberia_active } oe_tmc_on_start = { r = iberia } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_britain_active } oe_tmc_on_start = { r = britain } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_persia_active } oe_tmc_on_start = { r = persia } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_blacksea_active } oe_tmc_on_start = { r = blacksea } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_arabia_active } oe_tmc_on_start = { r = arabia } }
}
# BYZ scope. Without a real muster: every theme with a strategos answered, one holds back, one refused.
oe_tmc_test_marks = {
    set_variable = oe_tmc_on
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tmc_n_regs } } set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_n_regs value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tmc_n_sent } } set_variable = { name = oe_tmc_n_sent value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { any_subject = { oe_tmc_sent_ok = yes } } }
        every_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes has_ruler = yes } set_variable = oe_tmc_sent }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { any_subject = { has_variable = oe_tmc_late } } }
        random_subject = { limit = { oe_tmc_sent_ok = yes } remove_variable = oe_tmc_sent set_variable = oe_tmc_late }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { any_subject = { has_variable = oe_tmc_refused } } any_subject = { count >= 3 oe_tmc_sent_ok = yes } }
        random_subject = { limit = { oe_tmc_sent_ok = yes } remove_variable = oe_tmc_sent set_variable = oe_tmc_refused }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Fire campaign event n (2-5) on marked themes (console: effect oe_tmc_fire = { n = 2 }); conditions unchecked.
oe_tmc_fire = {
    oe_tmc_test_marks = yes
    oe_tmc_pick_$n$ = yes
}
